body.heading: Where in the world is Niger?
paragraphs: Niger is a country in Western Africa, which is part of Africa.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Niger is Niamey.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Niger is French.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Niger is the West African CFA franc. The CFA franc is shared with neighbouring countries, so the same money works across the region.

body.heading: How big is Niger?
paragraphs: Niger covers about 1,267,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about twice the size of Somalia.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Agadez is a Sahara gateway of mud-brick houses and a towering minaret — the tallest mud-brick building of its kind — where camel caravans still arrive from the desert.
Named for the W-shaped bend in the Niger River, W National Park protects elephants, lions, cheetahs and hippos where Niger meets Burkina Faso and Benin.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Niger on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
